Community overlap

Across 1,225 NFT collection pairs, Mutant Ape Yacht Club and Bored Ape Kennel Club share the most holder addresses (2,872). Which collections share the most holder addresses? Choose a collection to find its five closest neighbors across this Ethereum sample.

One pair, two percentages

Mutant Ape Yacht Club and Bored Ape Kennel Club share 2,872 addresses, the largest raw overlap in this edition. Start from either side and the count stays the same. The percentage changes because each collection has a different holder population.

Trait studies

Explore 38,900 text trait values across 50 Ethereum NFT collections. Find the background colors, expressions and accessories that turn up in more than one collection.

Same label, different worlds

What do a smirk, a halo and a pair of 3D glasses have in common? Each turns up in the trait lists of several collections. Pick a label to see who shares it.

Matches use the same category and value, ignoring case and surrounding spaces. Counts come from each collection. Each pictured token has the selected trait in its metadata. Select the artwork to see the token on OpenSea.

Diamond hands

Of 736 verified tokens across Autoglyphs and DEAFBEEF, 67 have stayed at their mint-recipient address continuously. How long has each NFT been in its current wallet? Tenure starts at the most recent change of address. A self-transfer keeps the clock running.

Who kept the original?

Each square is one artwork, ordered by token number. Dark squares stayed at their mint-recipient address through the snapshot. Pale squares changed addresses at least once, even if the work eventually came back.

One square has a round trip behind it. DEAFBEEF #119 returned to its mint address on October 4, 2021. Its current hold starts with that return.
